description:
Office Rebel provides hands-on, executive-level office support to small businesses, Catholic organizations, and independent professionals across Colorado’s mountain communities. Whether you're managing a team, launching a retreat, or just trying to get through the paperwork, I bring decades of experience, and an old-school work ethic, to make your job easier.

As a Catholic convert and member of the Body of Christ, I believe in doing good work, serving others with integrity, and honoring the dignity of every client and employee. I offer faithful support for faith-driven businesses.

 CORE SERVICES INCLUDE:

EXECUTIVE & ADMINISTRATIVE SUPPORT
Calendar + inbox management, travel planning, documents, errands, and project organization. done with precision and reliability.

HUMAN RESOURCES + HANDBOOKS
Onboarding help, policy documents, job postings, compliance support, without the overhead of hiring full-time staff.

IN-PERSON ASSISTANCE & MOUNTAIN MOBILITY
From Evergreen to Vail and Steamboat to Salida, I bring real support to small towns that need it, clipboard in hand, ready to work.

Catholic-Owned & Christ-Centered

Grounded in traditional values and raised in a family business, I understand the mission behind your work. I proudly offer a 10% discount to members of the Colorado Catholic Business Network.
parish: St. Mary of the Assumption - Central City
